config.script:
listCustom = [
		"answers"
	]
	
	for path in listCustom:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer3").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer4").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer6").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
	
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers.one_hour",
		"answers.half_hour",
		"answers.two_hour"
	]
	for path in listCustom:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))

	answer30min = self.view.custom.answers.half_hour
	answer1hour = self.view.custom.answers.one_hour
	answer2hour = self.view.custom.answers.two_hour
	papoID = self.view.params.papoID
	user = "Juliam Diaz"
	workstationNodeID = 1
	workstationID = 1
	nodeID = 4
	status = "En proceso"
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(3, system.util.jsonEncode(answer30min))  # 30 minutos
	insert_answer(1, system.util.jsonEncode(answer1hour))  # 1 hora
	insert_answer(2, system.util.jsonEncode(answer2hour))  # 2 horas
	
	self.view.params.lastRegisterType = 2
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshTable", 
	    payload={"estado": True,},
	    scope="session"
	)
